rangeStart.description: The datetime or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the beginning of the date range, included in dates.

rangeEnd.description: The datetime or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the end of the date range, excluded from dates.

title: The type to represent a range of dates for use in {@link UiSdlDateTimeRangeDataSpec}
